title: 6. Against: why graph features were removed and what to avoid

sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: Relation features have died unused before, and a general query language is ruled out. The case must stay narrow.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: Strategy contract 0ce48b8d excludes a general graph query language, and srs#726 warns that a query must never become a place where meaning lives. Decision 4f1e12e5 records dead features: relation-query in 0 of 13 sections, relation provenance in 0 of 250 relations, the old federation 34 prose records with no data. Carried context 287d4071: lifecycle needs looked like graph walking but were met twice without graph code. Decision 559bfb9e (experiment now, unify later) and one way per goal stand against a third selection construct. The graph-model survey (srs docs/research/graph-model-alignment.md, srs#368) adopts nothing. srs-rust#1086 shows unwanted relation expansion in rendering.

sections.name: open
sections.label: Open
sections.content: Has anyone outside the owner's projects asked for a graph view?
